name: Perspectives in Religious Studies (PRSt)
description: Established in 1972, Perspectives in Religious Studies (PRSt) is a publication produced for the National Association of Baptist Professors of Religion. This journal is now published quarterly and began with the first issue appearing in 1974. ISSN: 0093-531X | ISSN-L: 0093-531X

name: Perspectives on Baptist Identities
description: This book series provides a place for innovative approaches to baptist topics.

name: Mercer Dictionary of the Bible
description: The Mercer Dictionary of the Bible includes more than 1,000 pages of original materials relating to every aspect of biblical studies.

name: Mercer Commentary on the Bible
description: This one-volume commentary on the entire Bible distinguishes itself as a leading work in biblical studies.
